rfpText: The 18-year-old mainframe is approaching end of life, and failures threaten the stability of our claims platform. We need to modernize the legacy platform to prevent outages.

expectedPainPoints.summary: Modernize the mainframe before repeated failures disrupt claims operations.
expectedPainPoints.evidenceQuote: The 18-year-old mainframe is approaching end of life, and failures threaten the stability of our claims platform.

rfpText: Manual claims reconciliation creates rising operating costs and long turnaround times for the BFSI servicing team. We need to automate reconciliation and reduce labor overhead.

expectedPainPoints.summary: Automate claims reconciliation to lower operating costs and shorten turnaround time.
expectedPainPoints.evidenceQuote: Manual claims reconciliation creates rising operating costs and long turnaround times for the BFSI servicing team.

rfpText: Recent audit findings show gaps in KYC checks and access controls, creating regulatory exposure. We need to strengthen compliance controls before the next examination.

expectedPainPoints.summary: Strengthen KYC and access controls to reduce regulatory exposure.
expectedPainPoints.evidenceQuote: Recent audit findings show gaps in KYC checks and access controls, creating regulatory exposure.

rfpText: Customers abandon calls after long wait times and report inconsistent support across our contact center and digital channels. We need to improve customer satisfaction.

expectedPainPoints.summary: Improve cross-channel support to reduce wait times and abandoned calls.
expectedPainPoints.evidenceQuote: Customers abandon calls after long wait times and report inconsistent support across our contact center and digital channels.

rfpText: Our operations team cannot produce real-time inventory visibility or demand forecasts because sales data is siloed across reporting systems. We need better analytics and dashboards.

expectedPainPoints.summary: Unify sales data to enable real-time inventory visibility and demand forecasting.
expectedPainPoints.evidenceQuote: Our operations team cannot produce real-time inventory visibility or demand forecasts because sales data is siloed across reporting systems.
